title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Friday, 18 September 2026
description: Today: Canada and Germany back Yoshua Bengio's LawZero with $300m for safer AI as TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 nears; Albanese heads to the UN with a digital safety push while the Greens question the government's deportation plans; Queensland police search for an armed man near Greenvale and charge a teen with extremist offences; and a new report finds barely 1% of Gold Coast hotel rooms are accessible ahead of the 2032 Olympics. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
